sources.ref: NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2, B.E./B.Tech question paper 'B Tech 2nd Apr 2026 Shift 1' (English)

notes: Figures of ingested previous-year questions, to be recreated as diagrams through visual-director (never scanned). Each brief describes the official figure; labels are placed at anchors once an image exists.

requests.brief: three skeletal structural formulas on white, thin dark lines, each a benzene ring with an amino nitrogen carrying two methyl groups and a lone pair drawn as two dots: the first ring has only the dimethylamino group; the second ring also has one methyl group on the carbon next to the dimethylamino group; the third ring has methyl groups on both carbons next to the dimethylamino group; no letters drawn. Recreate the figure of NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper, 2 April Shift 1, question 68 faithfully (same parts, positions and directions); every letter, number, sign and arrow label is added by the app at label anchors.
must_show: three benzene rings each with an N bearing two methyl groups and a lone pair
no ring methyl in the first
one ortho methyl in the second
two ortho methyls in the third
must_not_show: a scan or copy of the original paper

alt.en: P is N,N-dimethylaniline. Q is N,N-dimethylaniline with one methyl group ortho to the nitrogen. R is N,N-dimethylaniline with methyl groups at both ortho positions.
alt.hi: P, N,N-डाइमेथिलऐनिलीन है। Q, N,N-डाइमेथिलऐनिलीन है जिसमें नाइट्रोजन के ऑर्थो पर एक मेथिल समूह है। R, N,N-डाइमेथिलऐनिलीन है जिसमें दोनों ऑर्थो स्थानों पर मेथिल समूह हैं।
